architecture_decision: Do not add request-context and Delay overhead merely to hoist compiler-context predicates and outer function-table reads. A future direct-dispatch candidate must reduce actual opcode resolution or interpreter dispatch work on authentic plans, preserve exact instruction/opcode/depth/results, bind exact plan/source/function identities, and demonstrate that request setup and allocation costs do not exceed the removed work.
